requirement.normalizedRequirement: (i) The average pressure, Pavg, within a design load patch is determined as follows: Pavg = F / (b * w) [MPa] where F = FBow or FNonBow as appropriate for the hull area under consideration [MN] b = bBow or bNonBow as appropriate for the hull area under consideration [m] w = wBow or wNonBow as appropriate for the hull area under consideration [m] (ii) Areas of higher, concentrated pressure exist within the load patch. In general, smaller areas have higher local pressures. Accordingly, the peak pressure factors listed in Table 3 are used to account for the pressure concentration on localized structural members.
requirement.section: Design ice loads - Pressure within the design load patch
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: (i) The average pressure, Pavg, within a design load patch is determined as follows: Pavg = F / (b * w) [MPa] where F = FBow or FNonBow as appropriate for the hull area under consideration [MN] b = bBow or bNonBow as appropriate for the hull area under consideration [m] w = wBow or wNonBow as appropriate for the hull area under consideration [m] (ii) Areas of higher, concentrated pressure exist within the load patch. In general, smaller areas have higher local pressures. Accordingly, the peak pressure factors listed in Table 3 are used to account for the pressure concentration on localized structural members.
